info.title: Trading API
info.description: Every trading REST route. x-scope is the permission an API key needs; a route with x-anonymous true also answers without a key. x-cost is what one call takes from the rate-limit bucket. Amounts are decimal strings. No server is listed: the owner has not set the hosts (see /developers/hosts).
